title: What stangent-fsd-writer returns (phase fs layer 4, D379, D387)
description: For each ruling that the code is right, the FSD's new sentence: the ruled sentence it replaces, word for word, the new words describing what the code does, and the code lines they describe. Code checks `replaces` is the ruled sentence, the words go in as one sentence, and every cite is a real path:line inside the entry's linked code; the new words replace only that sentence.

entry.description: The entry's id as the input names it: W1, W2, …

replaces.description: The sentence to replace, copied exactly as the input gives it.

sentence.description: The FSD's new words: what the code does, in the FSD's own style, one sentence or a short paragraph on one line, no Markdown heading or id marker.

cites.description: The code line(s) the new words describe, path:line or path:from-to, relative to the repo root, inside the code the entry is linked to.
